player_prompt.intro:
Tadakkest Mastermind.
Wakka ad takkest kudin yimɣuran {code_length} s ɣur, kud yimɣur s 1 ɣer {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Di tawilt-nnek, tzemreḍ ad teskelseḍ tawilt-nnek s yifuras-a: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Deg wakud n yimɣur, ad tetwaleḍ tawilt s tɣarɣart n yijjigen d yijjigen meqqren.
Ijjigen meqqren ad d-qqaren yimɣur yelha-d s wakud yelha, ma d yijjigen d yimɣur yelha-d s wakud ur yelhi.
Wakka {max_turns} n wakud i wakka ad teskelseḍ kudin.
